question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**encompasses.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blank 4 implies how education provides a better understanding and helps to explore a broader spectrum.**
 
• **Now, among the given options, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "encompasses.**"
 
 
• "Encompasses" means to include or contain within something larger or more comprehensive.(घेरना)
 
 
 
• The word is often used to describe a situation where one thing covers another. In this case it is the spectrum.
 
 
• Example: "The new policy encompasses all employees, from entry-level staff to upper management."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "defines," means to explain or describe something in detail.(को परिभाषित करता है)
 
• Option 2, "indicates," means to point out or show something.(दर्शाता है)
 
• Option 3, "signals," means to send a message or communicate something. (संकेत)
